component.name: Helm
component.summary: Manage, browse and monitor your servers over SSH
Gérer, parcourir et surveiller ses serveurs par SSH

description.p: Helm brings together what usually takes four separate tools: an SSH terminal with persistent sessions, an SFTP file browser, Docker management, databases, nginx sites, tunnels, backups and monitoring.

Helm réunit dans une seule application ce qui demande habituellement quatre outils : terminal SSH avec sessions persistantes, explorateur SFTP, gestion Docker, bases de données, sites nginx, tunnels, sauvegardes et supervision.

ul.li: Persistent terminals backed by tmux, with multi-server command broadcast
SFTP browser with remote search, server-side archives and file comparison
Docker containers, Compose projects and a one-click application catalogue
MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite and Redis explorers with in-place editing
Secrets kept in the system keyring, never in plain text
